desc:
🧸 Welcome to Steal A Squishy!

Sneak into squishy shops, steal the rarest squishies, and make it out
before the owners catch you!

💆 Train your Speed on the ASMR Table
🧸 Snatch squishies right under the Shop Owner's nose
🏃 Escape before the owner catches you
🥷 Race other players to grab the best ones first
💰 Display your collection and earn cash every second
🏠 Expand your base and unlock more shelf space
✨ Hunt for rare sizes, mutations, and secret squishies

🚨 The richer the shop, the angrier the Owner... and the better the loot.

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
